subject: Post-call: PaymentOps cost readout — batching & pilot asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Nguyen <sylvia@paystride.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0000
Subject: Post-call: PaymentOps cost readout — batching & pilot asks

Hi Sylvia —

Thanks again for a focused call earlier. Quick recap of what we heard and the smallest set of asks/action items to keep momentum: 

Key pain & goals (as we heard it)
- Live payments fraud classification and reconciliation are dominating infra spend — API call volumes spike at EOD settlements.
- Your team wants predictable monthly spend (budget = ~$35k/mo cloud for inference) and a plan that won’t regress accuracy for the two top-priority flows.
- Latency SLO for customer-facing lookups: 120–200ms p95; internal async batch jobs can accept higher latency.

Cost/TCO notes we discussed
- Token economics: at current prompt sizes (avg 340 tokens/request) and 1.2M monthly requests, hosted gen model baseline is ~1.5M generated tokens/day equivalently; rough hosted cost estimate in attached snapshot.
- Levers with highest impact: (1) request batching for EOD jobs (we estimate 60–75% token-cost reduction for large batches), (2) KV/prefix caching for recurring session patterns (likely saves 25–40% on p99 tails), (3) lower-precision quantized model variants for non-customer-facing scoring.
- Quick delta: with batching + caching + a mapped quantized model for background jobs, your unit cost per API call falls ~3–4x in our modeling vs naive hosted baseline. See paystride-cost-snapshot.pdf attached.

Proposed pilot (minimal risk)
- Scope: 6-week pilot — production shadow on 10% of traffic for scoring flow + EOD batch migration (no routing change for live lookups during week 1–2).
- Success criteria: maintain >=98% parity on historic evaluation set (AUC/precision) for customer flow; reduce month-over-month billed inference by >=35% on pilot traffic.
- Operational model options: Hosted API with intelligent routing OR Redwood Dedicated for guaranteed throughput — we’ll size both options and show 12-month TCO, you pick which to commit to.

Next steps (action items)
- From our side: we’ll circulate the cost snapshot and a one-page pilot scope template (attached). Priyom will follow up with model sizing and a short ops checklist by EOD tomorrow.
- From your side: confirm whether procurement needs a PoC SOW or an MSA redline early — helps us prioritize legal docs and any necessary security evidence.

If that matches your recollection, I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk the pilot sizing and the cost delta.

Thanks —
Ben

-- 
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: paystride-cost-snapshot.pdf (9 pages), pilot-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Sylvia Nguyen <sylvia@paystride.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@paystride.com, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 17:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: PaymentOps cost readout — batching & pilot asks

Ben —

Appreciate the clear write-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Budget: the $35k/mo is what finance will carve out for a production run; procurement is open to a higher committed spend if we get an explicit 12-month TCO and SLA.
- Accuracy tolerance: we can accept up to 1.5% drop in F1 for non-customer-facing scoring but need <0.2% for live customer matches.
- Security/compliance: procurement will need the SOC2 attestation and a list of controls around KV cache retention and purge.

Procurement is looped on the legal ask (procurement@paystride.com). Please include security evidence in your next packet. Looking forward to the sizing.

—Sylvia
Sylvia Nguyen
Head of Payments Product, PayStride
 sylvia@paystride.com | +1 (212) 555-0920
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: PaymentOps cost readout — batching & pilot asks

Sylvia —

Thanks for the quick clarifications. Short answers and attachments we’re sending in this thread: 

- TCO & SLA framing: attached one-pager and the cost snapshot includes a 12-month committed scenario (we included a committed discount band that brings your monthly equivalent below $30k for a 12-month Dedicated commit at the modeled throughput).
- Security evidence: SOC2 status + short KMS/HSM note are in the shared Drive link below; we’ll also produce a cache-retention/Purge playbook for the pilot.
- Accuracy: we’ll run the 98–99% parity checks on both the live-run eval set and the replayed EOD batch set; we’ll share the validation script and expected metric outputs before the pilot start.

Attached: paystride-cost-snapshot.pdf, pilot-scope.xlsx
Shared link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEfgHIj

Proposed logistics: 30-min sync next Wed 2027-08-18 at 10:00am ET to review final sizing and SOW ask. If that works for you, Ben will send a calendar invite.

Priyom
